description: Buys what a quote is for, charging its price to the account's prepaid API balance (never a card). At most $50 an order and $200 a day. Episodes that are never transcribed are refunded automatically. Needs the "order" scope.

idempotency_key.description: Any unique string; retrying with the same one never pays twice.
